name: atk
description: AI Team Kit - 12 skills covering the software delivery lifecycle of a company project team: requirement intake, estimation, technical design, task breakdown, conventions, code review, QA, release, incident response, retrospective, onboarding, and handover

interface.shortDescription: Run the delivery lifecycle of a project team: intake, estimate, design, breakdown, review, QA, release, incident, retro
interface.longDescription: AI Team Kit turns the habits of a company project team into 12 repeatable skills. It clarifies a stakeholder request into user stories with acceptance criteria, estimates and fills a sprint against real capacity, writes the technical design document and the ADR behind it, breaks an epic into owned tasks, records the team coding conventions, reviews a pull request against them, plans and writes the test cases, ships the release with a checklist and a rollback path, runs an incident to a blameless postmortem, holds a retrospective with follow-up actions that have owners, onboards a new member, and hands work over when a member or a phase changes. Every artifact is Markdown first, so it works whether the team tracks work in GitHub Issues, Jira, Backlog, or Redmine.
defaultPrompt: Turn this customer request into user stories with acceptance criteria.
Break this epic into tasks and assign owners.
Write the technical design document for this feature.
Review this pull request against our team conventions.
Run a blameless postmortem for last night's incident.
